limitations: The complete 76-page PACMA programme was fully read previously. This audit reuses that notebook and the current byte-identical primary original; no new owner or reading count.

Two new qualified +1 decisions preserve the source restrictions: free school meals only for vulnerable families; free internet points only for people at risk of social exclusion. Neither becomes a universal guarantee.
Twenty-one prior numeric mappings and the cited deposit-return ambiguity retain their exact values, rationales and citations.

Universal nursery access and general real-gratuity language do not explicitly connect free places to every 0–3 applicant. Generic healthcare copay opposition does not name pharmaceutical contributions. Public school early-development support does not explicitly establish the full public/free entitlement.
Social housing for purchase or rental does not identify an exact public-stock sale rule. Psychosocial support and mental-health care do not explicitly name public clinical psychotherapy.
Only 51 proclaimed PACMA Congress ballots apply, including restored Teruel. Ceuta remains excluded. No territorial or party inheritance.
References to the 2017 Ley Cero, the science charter and unspecified CERMI proposals do not automatically import every external provision. Their exact adopted versions remain uncertified.

Assembly, literal citation validation, all independent calibration cases, 53 scopes with seven profiles and 48 real browser sessions passed. These bounded checks do not certify entire-corpus semantic infallibility, final-interface, production-host or public-launch acceptance.
